entities.summary: Craig Michael Kimbrel is an American professional baseball pitcher in the New York Mets organization. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Atlanta Braves, San Diego Padres, Boston Red Sox, Chicago Cubs, Chicago White Sox, Los Angeles Dodgers, Philadelphia Phillies, Baltimore Orioles, and Houston Astros. He is a nine-time All-Star, four-time Reliever of the Year, and a 2018 World Series champion. Internationally, Kimbrel represented the United States.
